frozen_scope_note: Frozen for the plan's EXACT invariants only (adaptive_RX_pipeline.md sections 3.3/4/5.4 and the 2026-09-11 TESTING MODE RULE amendment). Every deployment-dependent limit below is UNSET; an UNSET limit means the gate is incomplete, not an automatic pass. Do not invent favorable limits after viewing results (section 3.3).

exact_source_config_binary_identity.rationale: adaptive_RX_pipeline.md section 3.3: 'A gate passes only with source/config/binary identity, exact command, retained artifacts, explicit assertions and reviewable results.' Enforced via tests/passive_rx/baseline_manifest.sh + check_manifest.py.

zero_unexplained_baseline_sample_loss.rationale: adaptive_RX_pipeline_progress.md 'Acceptance-profile record': 'Acquisition and sample continuity requirements' = 'Exact identity; no unexplained baseline sample loss'. G0 exit (section 4) requires reproducible baseline captures with explained loss only.

baseline_launcher_exit_code.rationale: tests/passive_rx/run_adaptive_receive_test.sh's own VALID verdict requires the bounded 'timeout' wrapper to end the run (exit 124 = timeout fired, i.e. the receiver survived to its declared duration rather than exiting early/abnormally); any other exit is recorded VOID_ABNORMAL_EXIT_<rc>.

no_rf_tx_calls_in_passive_mode.rationale: adaptive_RX_pipeline.md section 1: 'The receiver remains passive.' Section 4 Stage 6 tests: 'no RF TX calls in passive mode'.

single_hardware_owner.rationale: adaptive_RX_pipeline.md section 1: 'One process/component owns hardware acquisition... Four modem processes must not compete for the X410.' Section 3.1: AcquisitionOwner owns UHD reads.

ul_fusion_enable_default.rationale: adaptive_RX_pipeline.md section 5.4 proposed config concepts and section 8.2 (U00): 'Add a runtime flag, proposed name ul_fusion_enable, default false.'

full_auto_must_be_zero.rationale: adaptive_RX_pipeline.md section 1 TESTING MODE RULE (added 2026-09-11, user instruction): 'every test, replay and OTA capture under this plan MUST use MANUAL mode only -- pdcch_blind_monitor_full_auto = 0 ... A run executed in full-auto mode is VOID for every gate in this plan regardless of its result.'
